value: identical to the Barbu de Watermael except for lacking a tail

history_summary.value: The Barbu de Boitsfort is the most recent Belgian true bantam breed, created by crossing the Barbu de Watermael with the tail-less Barbu de Grubbe. It was first shown in 1997 and received full recognition in Belgium in 2001.
